note: Hand-drafted by the build agent from the saved live snapshot to exercise the watcher pipeline with a replay model. Not output of a live model run (no API key was available on 2026-11-01).

source.quote: Remove the Replays API (`/v1/Replays`, beta feature `api.eventstreams.replay`); the feature was never GA and is being sunset **(breaking change)**

changes.title: Conversations StartConversation request body drops channel/from/to/content for participants + action

source.quote: Restructured the `StartConversation` request body: removed the top-level `channel`, `from`, `to`, `content`, and `orchestratorPolicy` fields in favor of a `participants` roster plus a single dispatched `action` (`SEND_MESSAGE`, `START_FLOW`, or `CALL`) **(breaking change)**

changes.title: WhatsApp Senders v1 endpoints removed; use Senders v2 (/v2/Channels/Senders)

source.quote: Remove the WhatsApp Senders v1 endpoints (`/v1/Channels/WhatsApp/Senders`) from RestProxy; the sender was routed to the sunsetting `messaging-whatsapp-k8s-orch` downstream. Use the Senders v2 API (`/v2/Channels/Senders`) instead.

changes.title: IAM post_login action webhook payload drops user_context

source.quote: Removed user_context from the POST /v1/actions/post_login (PostLoginActionRequest) webhook payload; the login email is read from authentication_context.methods

changes.title: twiml_session resource deprecated in favor of twiml_process

source.quote: Add `twiml_process` resource alongside `twiml_session` (`twiml_session` is deprecated and will be removed in a future release)

changes.title: Verify Events: Verification Attempt DLR event type discontinued

source.quote: The Attempt DLR event type will be discontinued after September 22, 2026 at 10:00PM UTC.
Upgrade to Node.js >= 20 before updating to `twilio` 6.x.x
